facts.text: Ground truth must estimate the external physical scene independently of the system being evaluated, including required object identity and class, 3D position and trajectory in a common world or machine frame, machine pose and velocity, and timestamps for distances, risk-area transitions and warning timing.

facts.text: Using a production detector's own output as ground truth creates circular validation: missed objects disappear from both prediction and truth, making the baseline look deceptively good.
